task: Permission selection by true last payload reference: source boundary review
author: Codex independent critical-source seat; no DeepSeek in this task
execution: Targeted source reads and sha256 only. No model, RTL, build, board or test execution.

decision.positive: A legal new choice can be made among not-yet-offered owned preparation candidates, before any public TL VALID and before any AXI AW offer. The existing walker can remain nonpreemptive.
decision.native_limit: Four independently owned pending WRITE permissions are not four native TC/TL candidates. Native banked TC has two lifecycle tags, one FSM per bank, and FIFO-head selection only. Root four-recipient mechanism requires an explicit four-entry pre-AW preparation interface or a larger TC/queue architecture.
decision.release_semantics: TL success and R handshake are not payload last-reference releases. A scheduling score can predict releases, but accounting must use the actual shared-pool W/spill handoff with no remaining hard owner; permission result ownership is separate.
decision.novelty_scope: This review establishes an implementable interface boundary, not prior-art coverage or performance. FIFO/RR/occupancy controls must receive the same four-entry preparation queue, native hit path, owned results and payload budget before comparison.

actual_call_chain.fact: Nonzero IOMMUNonblockMode enables BankedEnable and NonblockEnable; mode 3 enables composition policy. Default parameter mode remains zero, so banked reasoning is explicitly about the research composition configuration.

Eight outstanding-header entries and 32 W words globally become four header entries and 16 W words per bank. Address=64, PA=56, data=64 bits. These are real payload buffers and cannot be silently omitted from a P5 total-store comparison.

READ and WRITE have independent input FIFOs, but not independent translation FSMs. IDLE selects the AW head first when !w_cnt_ovf, otherwise eligible AR head. It cannot inspect/reorder the next AW in that FIFO.

REQ_TRANS offers the saved request. Handshake moves to AWAIT_RESP; result handshake saves the whole result; COMPLETE holds translated header until downstream AR/AW handshake, then pops the selected original FIFO head and returns IDLE. It does not wait for RLAST, WLAST or B before accepting a future translation.

Two bank requests merge through stable RR; only bank bit is added. Responses fan out data but assert valid to the matching bank; ready comes from that bank. At most one translation lifecycle per bank makes this bit sufficient today.

Normal/debug/ATS priority merge enters a nonbypass two-register spill. The active original request is retired from the spill only on response handshake. Nonblock research gate admits slow work only while IDLE/no active request; another-bank native hit may be intercepted during an active S-only walk. A rejected hit probe is not accepted. Fast and slow responses merge normally.

The chosen request drives directory/context checks, then IOTLB lookup; only a miss initiates PTW. PTW latches its walk state in IDLE and offers immutable PTE AR in MEM_ACCESS until handshake. There is no owner-select input for replacing an active walk.

irreversible_boundaries.point: Public normal TL request first VALID
irreversible_boundaries.constraint: RR locks its decision when VALID and !READY. A later better candidate may not replace the held public request. Local bank REQ_TRANS VALID can stay asserted with READY=0 while a new scheduler has not yet offered any public VALID.
Owned request is now captured and must reach its original response owner. Spill is two physical request records, not permission to withdraw or reassign the request.

irreversible_boundaries.point: PTW initialization / first PTE AR VALID
irreversible_boundaries.constraint: No midwalk scheduling. In particular a stalled AR_VALID is not an uncommitted choice.

irreversible_boundaries.point: Input AXI AW first offer, even before AW handshake
irreversible_boundaries.constraint: The demux increments W-owner obligation on AW offer and holds the selected owner until input WLAST acceptance. A fake AW is not a harmless permission query. Prepared but unoffered metadata must use a separate origin.

Native R handshake pushes DMA byte FIFO; native DMA W handshake pops it while transferring actual W data to a following buffer. In a unified token design ownership must transfer to any output spill/WFIFO before that same cell can be freed, and a held R/W offer remains pinned.

payload_and_two_candidate_reachability.write_wait_with_payload: Yes. TC frees a READ translation lifecycle at physical AR acceptance (not RLAST); later WRITE permission can wait while those R responses arrive. Incoming W can enter the TC W FIFO before WRITE permission success; w_cnt==0 prevents outgoing W but does not stop incoming W FIFO acceptance. This is reachable for admitted/previous source reads, not permission to bypass bank read_admit rules.
payload_and_two_candidate_reachability.two_write_heads: The two bank head request signals are visible to the bank merge, so a replacement admission scheduler can compare them if both are pending before its first offer. Such a two-candidate opportunity is conditional, not guaranteed at every native walk boundary. With one slow walk owning one bank, only the other bank can expose a new lifecycle; early public VALID can lock that sole pending candidate before the returning bank becomes eligible again.
payload_and_two_candidate_reachability.input_w_owner_limit: Cross-bank AW cannot enter while earlier owner has unaccepted input WLAST. For a blocked short write fitting the remaining per-bank 16-word W FIFO, complete W can be buffered and input owner can retire, allowing another-bank AW to enter before first WRITE permission finishes. For longer blocked writes, lack of FIFO space prevents this construction. Input WLAST is not physical W retirement.
payload_and_two_candidate_reachability.four_root_candidates: A,C,B,D may be known DMA descriptors or queued AWs, but are not four free native TL heads. Same-bank FIFO tails are not exposed, and four AXI AW offers would also impose real W-order obligations. A four-entry logical preparation queue before common AXI AW/W commitment is therefore necessary for the stated simultaneous four-candidate comparison.
payload_and_two_candidate_reachability.pool_budget_condition: If using P5 shared payload cells, native TC 32-word W FIFO and AXI spills must be replaced with token/meta ownership or counted. Copying all words into those old buffers changes the cell owners and the resource bound. No total-P5 native reachability claim is made here.

minimum_implementable_new_interface.placement: Four owned DMA destination preparation records before any common AXI AW offer. Select one ready record, then present a native WRITE translation request through an explicit prepare origin. The TL still performs its normal context/IOTLB/PTW permission checks; no mandatory extra walk on a native hit.
minimum_implementable_new_interface.record_core: For stable Normal S-only WRITE preparation, each slot must associate destination IOVA, DID, PID-valid/PID, privilege, destination span/descriptor identity, state and later owned translation result. Existing descriptor fields may be referenced rather than duplicated only if their storage lifetime is actually retained and charged.
minimum_implementable_new_interface.type_cost: Native trans_req_data is 118 bits: IOVA64+DID24+PIDvalid1+PID20+ttype6+priv1+debug1+bank1. Replace bank1 with route_tag3 for six owner values (normal bank0/1 and prepare0..3) to preserve native request fields at 120 bits; both request and response need +2 route bits through stored/held paths. Simpler separate prepare-origin+slot2 retaining bank costs +3 bits instead. Existing debug/ATS classification still uses existing fields and must not collide.
minimum_implementable_new_interface.core_storage_lower_bound: Restricted WRITE-only queue request core is 110 bits/slot (IOVA64+DID24+PID20+PIDvalid1+priv1), four entries=440 bits, plus at least two state bits/slot=8. This excludes destination extent, descriptor ID, permission epoch, prepared PA/results, fairness and shared-cell ownership metadata. It is a logical field count, not an asserted incremental LUT count; retained existing descriptor storage can satisfy some fields but is not free capacity.
minimum_implementable_new_interface.result_cost: A reusable prepared result minimally needs owned PA56, range3, explicit access_ok1 and status plus its descriptor/span/context association. Actual native response/error fields must be routed as required; no general permission-epoch or fault-completion implementation is claimed. Complete headers/PA can reuse already-consumed fields only with a documented lifetime projection.
minimum_implementable_new_interface.commit_control: Add TL slow-slot-available indication (derived from actual empty/IDLE intake state) for the new scheduler, and selected-owner lock state before first public VALID. Keep output VALID zero while not selecting; after first VALID, freeze selection through handshake even if release score changes. For four slots, selection tag=2 bits plus held flag=1; tie/fairness state is extra. Do not dynamically change the old RR while its output is already held.
minimum_implementable_new_interface.nonblock_preservation: Suppressing all normal public requests during a slow walk would remove the current N hit opportunity. Keep native normal candidate/hit interception semantics separate from the new preparation selection, or explicitly charge the lost opportunity. Adding four-origin nonblock hit support is not free; it requires owner routing/eligibility changes.
changed_modules: DMA/pre-AW preparation owner queue and trusted destination dispatch boundary
rv_iommu_tl_wrap prepare input, stored owner echo, access verdict and slow admission indication
shared-pool owner scoreboard/actual W lease retirement feedback
minimum_implementable_new_interface.unchanged_walker_goal: PTW/DDTW/PDTW memory service can remain serial and nonpreemptive; no added memory read port is required by selection alone. Actual synthesis/timing costs are not measured.

owned_success_and_error.native_route: slow_resp_data.bank=req_data.bank (TL462); bank403-408 routes valid/ready; TC698-701 saves result. COMPLETE converts saved spaddr into physical AR/AW (333-357). Header dispatch completion is different from payload/B completion.
owned_success_and_error.access_ok_gap: Native response has error, W/R/X, range and fault_code, but no explicit access_ok. DTF can route a failed permission check directly to COMPLETE at TL1307,1380,1397 without taking ERROR (where error_n is set). Therefore neither error==0 nor fault_code==0 is a general preparation-success certificate. Preparation origin must latch the actual complete authorization decision independently of reporting; the scheduler cannot manufacture authority.
owned_success_and_error.failure_ownership: A denied/suppressed-fault preparation returns to its exact slot and descriptor, never to a new head. Failed job cleanup must remove only that job reference and respect any already-held R/W obligation. Existing ordinary native error slave routing does not establish a new DMA descriptor failure contract.

necessary_neighbor_controls.state: A and C own the same three resident cells; each sole grant predicts zero free cells; their two actual W retirements can free all three. B and D each singly own one cell. All four WRITE preparation metadata are pending.
necessary_neighbor_controls.requirement: A last-reference scheduler must remain work-conserving even when each current marginal score is zero. Waiting until one candidate by itself releases storage can deadlock. A bounded pair plan is legal only before public offers and must be invalidated/recomputed as actual owners retire, without cancelling the locked request.

necessary_neighbor_controls.case: Unusable high-score owner and starving source read
necessary_neighbor_controls.state: High predicted-release prepare belongs to a writer behind an already-offered no-ID W owner, or cannot form resident W because its own source READ is pending.
necessary_neighbor_controls.requirement: Granting it does not itself free payload; do not count it as an immediately drainable release. Preserve existing owner/source admission and bounded service fairness among READ and WRITE work. Age override at uncommitted admission boundaries prevents endless preference for arriving high-score work; this gives an admission-count bound only while native translations/fault sinks/memory eventually complete, not a cycle guarantee.

next_gate: Freeze explicit four-entry preparation and result budget plus total payload/spill capacity; then compare last-reference pair selection against same-interface work-conserving RR/FIFO and per-owner occupancy/blocked-count priorities. Require a reachable resident four-recipient scenario and real retirement events. Current source review alone does not validate speed or board behavior.
